definitions.technical_candidate: New V3 code/CI may be PASS while economic strategy utility remains UNKNOWN.
definitions.suitable_setup: Prospective same-clock Kraken EUR tradable market and time-stamped valid setup, with any required stop/stage2 execution facts known at decision time.
definitions.buy: BUY_SCOUT only after full independent risk and fee check plus valid stop below ask and stage2 confirmation above ask; no fabricated BUY on missing core evidence.
definitions.trade: Only executed Paper/Shadow fill tracked with actual assumptions, 6h/24h path and realized model costs; an MFE proxy or model suggestion is not a trade.
definitions.strategy_success: MORE VALID NET-POSITIVE PUBLISHED COMPARABLE TRADE OPPORTUNITIES AFTER COSTS, with bounded risk and no rise in false positives/stop-outs, not raw BUY count.
definitions.unknown: Optional data absent is neutral/context unavailable; required source/price/risk proof unavailable is UNKNOWN/NO_EXECUTION and counted as input failure, not bearish strategy rejection.

package_order.work: Preserve Kraken *online* public Spot-EUR pair metadata, min order, fresh bid/ask and spread. Full risk plan: stop below ask anchored to real structure/ATR, stage2 confirmation strictly above ask with TTL, scout 50 EUR + stage2 50 EUR, no adding losing trades, no lowering stops, no leverage or order rights. Fee 0.60% taker PER SIDE (1.2% roundtrip) plus spread+slippage and conservative fill/path assumptions. H4/H9/trailing and larger sizing only after enough actual mature paths and separate version release.
package_order.exit: Positive economic evidence after realistic costs and risk-adjusted drawdown; no false-looking profitable 'missed-move' replay using future MAE/MFE as prompt features.

findings.observed_finding: ZRO and LINK decisions required breakout/base/retest confirmation, FET was rejected at resistance and after fee hurdle; individual V2 verdicts contain no mature matched outcomes and do not prove the missed move was tradable.
findings.next_evidence_gate: Prospective eligible early CONTINUITY vs correctly avoided resistance cases, with complete stop/spread/net outcomes.

findings.observed_finding: Exactly one MON/EUR scout from the 1000 final cohort; stopped after about 29m at -1.5462 EUR/-3.0924% net including 0.5943 EUR modeled fees. No stage2 fills and no statistically valid stop, sizing, trailing, take-profit or win-rate inference.
findings.next_evidence_gate: Tune stops/Stage2/trailing/sizing only on sufficient separate mature realized Paper paths.

findings.observed_finding: Frozen first 1000 clean paper decisions produced 1 BUY_SCOUT, 999 REJECT, 942 initial WAIT. More alerts or a high scanner rank alone cannot establish a safe entry.
findings.next_evidence_gate: Valid independent same-clock BUY/stop/Stage2/fill after cost, also false-buy rate.

findings.observed_finding: Among mature paths 891 WAIT became REJECT versus 1 WAIT→BUY; later movement alone cannot prescribe a BUY. Separate temporarily unattractive entry from irrevocably bad setup.
findings.next_evidence_gate: Fresh watchable-event recheck with non-buy control, cost feasibility and bounded retries, not auto-buy.

findings.observed_finding: The early CONTINUITY sample n=16 had p50 MFE24 +5.8645% and p50 MAE24 -1.546%; next mature batch showed n=119 p50 MFE +2.579% and MAE -3.165%. Early apparent second-leg advantage weakened with larger sample; do not select winners from an optimistic first slice.
findings.next_evidence_gate: Pre-register sample/diversity/holdout and stratify CONTINUITY vs IGNITION/EXTENDED before picking a setup.

findings.observed_finding: 56 early resistance/breakout caution cases showed p50 later MFE24 +6.163%, but later n=310 yielded +3.632% with -3.520% MAE. Global resistance removal is not supported.
findings.next_evidence_gate: Separate fresh closed breakout/reclaim from false breakout with actual stop/net execution.

findings.observed_finding: Already-run final REJECTs had p50 MFE +3.821% versus +2.899% otherwise, but p50 MAE -4.133% versus -2.260% and median close -1.311% versus -0.077%. Raw upside does not warrant chase.
findings.next_evidence_gate: Fresh 1–3h base and closed reclaim, prepriced stop and fee-adjusted remaining move; adverse controls.

findings.observed_finding: Final score correlation with 24h MFE was -0.024 and with 24h close -0.035; high score did not empirically outrank lower scores in net trade quality.
findings.next_evidence_gate: Recalibrate a score only in separate prospective OOS cost-net comparison, no rank-triggered buys.

findings.observed_finding: 291 observations with 24h MFE>=5% reduce to 174 pair/6h market episodes, 103 >=10% observations to 65 pair/6h episodes; one FET/NIGHT move can produce many repeated alerts.
findings.next_evidence_gate: Always show candidate counts beside deduplicated pair/UTC-window episodes and clustered uncertainty.

findings.observed_finding: At 24h p50 final close varies by observation date from +0.946% to -3.791%; 05 Oct batch +0.835% median was below 1.2% roundtrip taker hurdle even before spread/slippage.
findings.next_evidence_gate: Same-clock matched regime/UTC-day cohorts with negative controls, no retroactively chosen trading hours.

findings.observed_finding: 59 later-matured final REJECT cases had p50 MAE24 -6.313% and close24 -4.570%, with only 6 reaching >=5% MFE and none >=10%. Excluding late losers would inflate opportunity quality.
findings.next_evidence_gate: All predeclared 24h followups and late tails retained with missing/censored labels; no survivorship bias.

findings.observed_finding: Original V2R4 72h 1677 candidates, 0 BUY/0 fills. 127 genuine trigger→model rechecks ended 125 REJECT/2 WAIT, while 946 WAIT expired untriggered. A faster event path by itself did not produce a viable buy.
findings.next_evidence_gate: Measured WAIT→trigger→valid full model decision→risk-feasible BUY→Paper fill funnel, separate policy from timing.

findings.observed_finding: At 1696 initial V2R4 candidates, 436 complete 24h paths, 178 MFE>=5%, 300 MAE<=-5% and 98 paths with BOTH extremes; 861 EXTENDED setups and 195/270 mature EXTENDED MAE<=-5%. Late buy liberalization risks severe false buys.
findings.next_evidence_gate: Event-time price path with known-at entry, stop-first vs high-first ordering, spread/slippage, invalidations.

findings.observed_finding: Only 32 optimistic proxies/24 pair-hours among 436 mature cases satisfy MFE>=5%, MAE>=-3%, close>1.2% and spread<=0.5%; proxy ignores entry time, stop sequence, Stage2, slippage and exit. Must never be counted as 32 lost profits.
findings.next_evidence_gate: Decision-time entry-to-fill-to-stop/stage2-to-exit and actual risk/net return verified prospectively.

findings.observed_finding: Six outcome-selected favorable cases matched to six adverse controls by lane: CONTINUITY STRK/WLD and OP/GRT; EXTENDED BAT/ORCA and W/ALGO; IGNITION JUP/ADA; NONE DRV/SYN. STRK +47.37% MFE vs WLD -14.04% MAE illustrates discrimination question, not evidence that future labels were known at entry.
findings.next_evidence_gate: Use sealed future labels; real prospective first-time coin candles+ATR+vol to separate good and bad under same setup lane.

findings.observed_finding: Some rejected EXTENDED candidates (BAT/W) later rallied while ORCA/ALGO sharply fell. Prior 7d/30d extension must not forever kill an independent fresh setup, but historic label itself cannot authorize an immediate market buy.
findings.next_evidence_gate: New observed contiguous closed 15m consolidation/reclaim with unchanged anti-chase and full net-risk evaluator.

findings.observed_finding: CONTINUITY, EXTENDED, IGNITION and unclassified NONE can each include later upside and large downside; early volume/momentum confirmation and a later confirmed second leg are different hypotheses. Do not hardwire a winner from six handpicked success cases.
findings.next_evidence_gate: Pre-register one lane at a time, compare natural false-breakouts/early impulse samples with adverse controls.
